description: This table contains the performance obligation line distribution information.

columns.description: Posting batch identifier. -3 Indicates unposted distributions.

columns.name: POSTED_TO_SLA_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a revenue line is posted to subledger application.

columns.name: POSTED_TO_SLA_DATE
columns.description: Date when the revenue is posted to the subledger application.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_GL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the accounting distribution is eligible for posting to Oracle Fusion General Ledger.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a subledger accounting event.

columns.name: COGS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The Enterprise Service Scheduler request ID of the COGS job that processed the row.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a ledger.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from entered currency to ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for converting amounts from entered currency to ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion rate date used for converting amounts from entered currency to ledger currency.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
